verses.html: A Song of degrees. In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
verses.text: A Song of degrees. In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
verses.title: A Song of degrees.

verses.html: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
verses.text: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

verses.html: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
verses.text: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

verses.html: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

verses.html: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
verses.text: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

verses.html: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
verses.text: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

verses.html: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.text: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
